design.A_B_pairing: identical instances in A and B, so the A-vs-B gap is measured on the same charts
design.C_overlap: C's flawed rows are a subset of the A/B draw
design.strata: arity, then combination within it, for flawed rows; chart_type for clean rows
design.allocation: nested proportional, largest remainder at each level

image_paths: relative to source_root (images are not copied)
